# KiCad reference outputs of the blinky fixture

Generated by KiCad 10.0.6 from `crates/ew-kicad/tests/fixtures/blinky`
(a synthetic test project) with:

```sh
kicad-cli pcb export gerbers -o out/ blinky.kicad_pcb
kicad-cli pcb export drill -o out/ blinky.kicad_pcb
```

`tests/kicad_reference.rs` imports the fixture, writes our Gerber and drill
files and compares both renderings pixel by pixel.
